events.title: The Comyths at BIC 2026
events.summary: The Comyths is coming to Busan Indie Connect Festival 2026!From August 14–16, The Comyths will be exhibited at BIC 2026 in Busan. Come experience its fast-paced bullet hell action, meet the six Scholars of Space, Time, Matter, Life, Mind, and Void, and discover the world of The Comyths in person.The game will be available to play throughout the exhibition, with both controller and portable setups available at the booth.Visitors can also pick up character photocards, brochures, and business cards

events.title: June Updates - Dev Milestone
events.summary: Hey there, Developer & Artist Kjorsell here! As promised, the Demo of the game has been released before the end of Q2 2026. I hope that it provided a great experience!A quick update from the developer!The gameplay is essentially finished, with additional polish being added here and there.The final stretch will focus on story production, creating hundreds of illustrations and integrating them into the game.Following the previous game announcement, the story system has been reworked to be fully op

events.title: Release Window & Demo Update
events.summary: Release Window UpdateThe release window has been moved to Q4 2026.Core gameplay is in a solid state, and we’re currently reworking the story delivery and presentation to better align with the experience. This requires additional development time, so the release window has been adjusted.A playable demo will be available before the end of Q2 2026, including the optional opening story premise, 3 out of 6 playable characters (Kunu, Evum, & Yusa), and the first six gameplay levels (up to a boss).
